rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for life or the fact of being alive, rather than for abstract existence alone.

example.english: Being alive is very important to me.
example.jyutping: sang1 ming6 deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this for existence as an abstract fact, especially in philosophical or formal discussion rather than for life itself.

example.english: The being of God has been debated by philosophers for years.
example.traditional: 神嘅存在係哲學家爭論多年嘅問題。
example.jyutping: san4 ge3 cyun4 zoi6 hai6 zit3 hok6 gaa1 zang1 leon6 do1 nin4 ge3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this for a person's basic character or personality.

example.english: Their being easygoing makes them easy to get along with.
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 sing3 gaak3 hou2 ceoi4 wo4

rows.note: Use this for a living creature or organism as opposed to an inanimate thing.

example.english: I saw a strange being on the seabed.
example.traditional: 我喺海底見到一種奇怪嘅生物。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 hoi2 dai2 gin3 dou2 jat1 zung2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 sang1 mat6
